column1: # Atmosphere prefabs that batch roots pull their settings from, extracted by
# overrideBiome = AtmosphereVolume.overrideBiome, replacing whatever the batch file said.
# overrideBiome cannot be read here -- the value is inside an addressable bundle -- so it
# is filled in from what the game itself reported: the `lmsbiomes` console command,
# whose full output is atmosphere-biomes.tsv. Preserved on rewrite. A dash means the prefab
# carries no biome of its own, which wipes whatever string the batch file carried.
# replacesLiteral counts the batches where this prefab overwrites a string that IS in
# biome-overrides.tsv -- for every one of them, both sources name the same tournament biome.
